title_sq: Liqeni i Thatë | Jepet me qira apartament 2+1+2 me parkim të përfshirë
description_sq:

title_en: Dry Lake | 2+1+2 apartment for rent with parking included
description_en: 📍 Location: Dervish Hekali Street, behind the Red School - a developed, accessible and highly sought-after residential area. 🔹 Interior organization: Living room + kitchen area 2 bedrooms 1 bathroom 2 balconies ✅ Additional quality works in the apartment: Walls refreshed and newly painted Quality parquet throughout the apartment Mitsubishi air conditioners with smart sensors Double glass windows for thermal and acoustic insulation Suspended ceiling and lighting with spotlights Household appliances from the most popular brands such as Bosch, Samsung, etc. 🅿️ Closed parking lot, located on the -2nd floor and is included in the price (with security shutter). 📄 Documentation: Possession certificate (regular mortgage). 📞 For more information or for a visit to the property, please do not hesitate to contact me.
